title: Oily Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish made with lamb, tarragon, and a soffritto base, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters looking for a rich and flavorful meal. It is dairy-free friendly and features a unique blend of French and Algerian flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots, tarragon, tomato paste, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh tarragon.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
